payload.summary: CP-HARDEN-03 unclaimed external-change ingress detection is implemented and merged. The incremental ledger watches relevant repository PR merges and direct commits after an explicit baseline, matches canonical claim/checkpoint evidence, and persists fail-closed UNRECONCILED incidents for Main/Reviewer reconciliation.
payload.next_action: Synchronize authoritative hardening state to mark CP-HARDEN-03 complete and make CP-HARDEN-06 the next bounded phase. Keep AIR-10 broad rollout constrained.
decisions: Use an explicit deployment baseline and incremental cursors; do not retroactively flood the control plane with historical merges.
Treat PR #747 as a historical motivating example already reconciled before the baseline rather than reopening it without new evidence.
A merged PR is matched by an active canonical claim on the same repository and branch or by explicit repository-qualified PR/merge-SHA evidence in raw workstreams.
Direct default-branch commits are watched on external project repositories; Module Library direct control-plane reconcile commits are excluded while its PR merges remain watched.
Unmatched changes persist as UNRECONCILED incidents and the watchdog fails closed until Main/Reviewer records reconciliation evidence.
RECONCILED incidents require reviewed_by=main-reviewer and non-empty evidence_refs.
The external ingress watchdog shares the canonical-control-plane-reconcile concurrency group and does not directly mutate workstreams or canonical-state.
